profile.headline: Software Engineer at Yancey Bros. Co.
profile.summary:
I am a versatile and highly skilled professional with a passion for technology and a strong background in a wide range of tools and methodologies. With expertise in TypeScript, ServiceNow, MS Power Apps, Angular, C#, JavaScript, Jelly, Visual Studio, Java, SQL, and experience in gathering business requirements, I am committed to delivering innovative solutions that drive business success.

My journey began in the world of software development, where I honed my skills in TypeScript, C#, and Angular, creating dynamic web applications and crafting efficient, maintainable code. My proficiency extends to various technologies, from MS Power Apps to JavaScript, enabling me to adapt to diverse project requirements with ease.

My development toolkit includes not only a strong technical foundation but also a keen eye for detail, as well as a knack for understanding and gathering business requirements. This enables me to bridge the gap between technology and real-world business needs, resulting in solutions that truly make a difference.

Agile and Scrum methodologies are familiar to me, as I value collaboration and adaptability in project management. I excel in multidisciplinary teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and quick, efficient delivery.

My diverse skill set, combined with my ability to adapt and thrive in various technology stacks, positions me as a valuable asset for businesses seeking innovative solutions. I'm dedicated to continuous learning and growth, ensuring that I stay at the forefront of technology and best practices.
